title: Baicalin methyl ester prevents the LPS - induced mice intestinal barrier damage in vivo and in vitro via P65/TNF-alpha/MLCK/ZO-1 signal pathway.
authors: Liang, Mei; Sun, Xinyi; Guo, Mengru; Wu, Huining; Zhao, Linlu; Zhang, Jin; He, Jieyi; Ma, Xingbin; Yu, Zhichao; Yong, Yanhong; Gooneratne, Ravi; Ju, Xianghong; Liu, Xiaoxi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄芩苷甲酯通过P65/TNF-alpha/MLCK/ZO-1信号通路缓解LPS诱导的肠道屏障损伤，属于炎症信号通路与肠道屏障的湿实验研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: The effect of baicalin methyl ester (BME) on the regulation of mice intestinal barrier in the inflammatory response was studied in vivo and in vitro. Thirty six C57/BL mice were randomly divided into six groups (n = 6): control group; LPS group (LPS 3.5 mg/kg given intraperitoneal [ip] on day 7 of the study only), PBS group, and three BME groups (low: 50 mg/kg; medium: 100 mg/kg; high: 200 mg/kg) orally dosed with BME for 7d and LPS ip on day 7. All mice were sacrificed on day 8, and jejunum tissue collected for histopathology (H&E and PAS staining), protein expression of pro-inflammatory factors (TNF-alpha, IL-6, IL-8, IFN-gamma) by ELISA, and intestinal tight junction proteins (ZO-1, occludin, claudin-1 and claudin-4) by Western Blot. Compared with the control group, LPS significantly increased the serum cytokines DAO (p < 0.01) and DLA (p < 0.01), upregulated the expression of pro-inflammatory factors, MLCK proteins (p <0.05) and increased the MLCK/ZO-1ratio (p <0.001). LPS also decreased the expression of claudin-4 (p < 0.01) in the jejunum and induced an inflammatory response damaging the jejunal mucosal barrier. Pretreatment with BME (100-200 mg/kg) significantly decreased the cytokines DAO (p < 0.05) and DLA (p < 0.01) in the serum, pro-inflammatory factors in the jejunum, significantly down-regulated the expression of MLCK (p <0.05) and the ratio of MLCK/ZO-1(p <0.001) but upregulated the expressions of ZO-1(p < 0.01), occludin (p < 0.05), claudin-1(p < 0.05) and claudin-4 (p < 0.05), and thereby restored the intestinal tissue structure, suggestive of alleviation of LPS-induced intestinal inflammation by BME. In vitro, MODE-K cells (derived from mice intestinal epithelium) were exposed to BME at 0 (control group-No LPS), 10, 20 and 40 muM BME for 24 h prior to LPS addition at 50 mug/mL for 2 h. LPS significantly increased the expression of pro-inflammatory factors, MLCK (p < 0.01) and the ratio of MLCK/ZO-1(p <0.001), decreased the expressions of ZO-1 (p < 0.05), occludin (p < 0.01), claudin-1 (p < 0.01) and claudin-4 (p < 0.01) in MODE-K cells compared with the control group. Compared with the LPS group, BME (10 - 40 muM) significantly decreased the expression of pro-inflammatory factors, MLCK (p < 0.05) and the ratio of MLCK/ZO-1(p <0.01) but increased the expressions of ZO-1(p < 0.01), occludin (p < 0.05) and claudin-4(p < 0.01) indicating an up-regulation of the expression of tight junction proteins by BME. On addition of extrinsic TNF-alpha plus LPS, the TNF- alpha level increased (p < 0.001) in MODE-K cells and the protein expression of MLCK (p < 0.01) was markedly up-regulated. Molecular docking predicted BME interacted with P65 by forming hydrogen bonds. IP-WB further confirmed that BME was directly bound to P65 protein in MODE-K cells. In conclusion, BME was able to restore the intestinal barrier through the P65 / TNF-alpha / MLCK / ZO-1 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 本研究通过体内和体外实验探讨了黄芩苷甲酯（BME）对炎症反应中小鼠肠道屏障的调节作用。将36只C57/BL小鼠随机分为六组（每组n=6）：对照组；LPS组（仅在研究第7天腹腔注射LPS 3.5 mg/kg）；PBS组；以及三个BME组（低剂量：50 mg/kg；中剂量：100 mg/kg；高剂量：200 mg/kg），连续口服BME 7天，并在第7天腹腔注射LPS。所有小鼠于第8天处死，收集空肠组织用于组织病理学检查（H&E和PAS染色）、通过ELISA检测促炎因子（TNF-alpha、IL-6、IL-8、IFN-gamma）的蛋白表达，以及通过Western Blot检测肠道紧密连接蛋白（ZO-1、occludin、claudin-1和claudin-4）。与对照组相比，LPS显著增加了血清细胞因子DAO（p < 0.01）和DLA（p < 0.01），上调了促炎因子和MLCK蛋白的表达（p < 0.05），并增加了MLCK/ZO-1比值（p < 0.001）。LPS还降低了空肠中claudin-4的表达（p < 0.01），并诱导了炎症反应，损伤了空肠黏膜屏障。BME预处理（100-200 mg/kg）显著降低了血清中的DAO（p < 0.05）和DLA（p < 0.01）细胞因子、空肠中的促炎因子，显著下调了MLCK的表达（p < 0.05）和MLCK/ZO-1比值（p < 0.001），但上调了ZO-1（p < 0.01）、occludin（p < 0.05）、claudin-1（p < 0.05）和claudin-4（p < 0.05）的表达，从而恢复了肠道组织结构，表明BME可缓解LPS诱导的肠道炎症。在体外实验中，将MODE-K细胞（来源于小鼠肠道上皮）暴露于0（对照组-无LPS）、10、20和40 μM的BME中24小时，然后加入50 μg/mL的LPS处理2小时。与对照组相比，LPS显著增加了MODE-K细胞中促炎因子、MLCK的表达（p < 0.01）和MLCK/ZO-1比值（p < 0.001），降低了ZO-1（p < 0.05）、occludin（p < 0.01）、claudin-1（p < 0.01）和claudin-4（p < 0.01）的表达。与LPS组相比，BME（10-40 μM）显著降低了促炎因子、MLCK的表达（p < 0.05）和MLCK/ZO-1比值（p < 0.01），但增加了ZO-1（p < 0.01）、occludin（p < 0.05）和claudin-4（p < 0.01）的表达，表明BME上调了紧密连接蛋白的表达。在添加外源性TNF-alpha和LPS后，MODE-K细胞中的TNF-alpha水平升高（p < 0.001），MLCK的蛋白表达（p < 0.01）显著上调。分子对接预测BME通过形成氢键与P65相互作用。IP-WB进一步证实BME在MODE-K细胞中直接与P65蛋白结合。总之，BME能够通过P65/TNF-alpha/MLCK/ZO-1信号通路恢复肠道屏障。
